title: A MAN SENT AFTER YOU SEARCHES THE RIGHT PLACE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08: a pillager or machine that once lost you kept that old search point for the rest of the raid. Shot later from cover, or called by his crew to a fresh sighting, he turned and walked toward the old spot, sometimes across the map, instead of coming for you. A search point now belongs to the target it was built for, and a new target more than 90 units away gets a new one. No dice the game uses are spent.
now: Pillagers and machines you shoot from cover come looking where you are, not where you used to be.
